descriptions.text: Fireball or Custard? Scratch off a spot in the midst of battle, and this zany ticket casts a spell at the closest red-tagged mob! Each spot has a 50/50 chance. Will it cast a level-15 Fireball? Will it cast a glob of delicious, healing Strawberry Custard? Who knows! Either way, the results will be a hoot! Thirty minute cooldown between scratches.

recap.text: Carl and Donut damage the rage elemental, a mob more than seventy-five levels above them, and each earns a Platinum Lucky Bastard Box. Both boxes hold a scratch-off ticket like any sold at a gas station. Donut's is Dungeon Gold Rush; Carl's has five spots, red on one side and pink on the other, with a cartoon dragon in the corner holding a spoon and licking its lips. Donut loves custard, and has the room's Bopca bring her some.

Carl saves his scratch-off ticket for a dire situation, and spends it on Heather, a flaming, skull-faced bear on roller skates with worms in her ribcage. It comes up custard: the splatter heals her, kills the worms, and leaves an old bear that two punches finish. Against the Krasue it comes up fireball, which rolls through a bedroom door, detonates against Featherfall's corpse, half collapses the room, and clears the red dots circling Donut.

Shut in a train car with no doors to the outside, Carl prepares a smoke curtain and moves the scratch-off ticket to his hotlist. The ticket has three spots left to scratch. If whatever is out there breaks in, they are screwed, and Carl knows no glob of custard will save him this time.

beats.headline: Luck goes both ways
beats.text: Damaging the rage elemental, a mob more than seventy-five levels above them, earns Carl and Donut each a Platinum Lucky Bastard Box: luck goes both ways, like your mom. Both hold a scratch-off ticket like any sold at a gas station. Donut's is Dungeon Gold Rush. Carl's has five spots and is red on one side and pink on the other, with a little cartoon dragon in the corner holding a spoon and licking its lips. Donut loves custard, and has the room's Bopca bring her some.
beats.gist: Carl and Donut earn Platinum Lucky Bastard Boxes for hurting the rage elemental, each holding a scratch-off ticket.

beats.headline: Custard comes up first
beats.text: Carl has been saving it for a dire situation, and Heather is one: a flaming, skull-faced bear on roller skates, her skin sloughing off to show a ribcage full of worms. He scratches a spot and a little icon spins between a red fireball and a pink glob. Custard. Yummy! says a voice like the Candy Crush announcer. A beachball-sized ball of custard splatters the bear. It boils against her, her skin and fur re-form in jerky clumps, and her health eases back up. Then the skates and the hat fall away: healing her has killed the worms. What is left is an old bear, dying on her own, and Carl finishes her with two punches.
beats.gist: Custard from the ticket heals Heather, kills her worms, and Carl punches her dead.

beats.headline: Then a fireball
beats.text: Krasue fill a smoking apartment and Donut is on the roof above with red dots circling her. Carl yanks the ticket, fully expecting custard again, and cries fire in the hole. Fireball. Spicy! An egg-shaped ball of fire the size of an opened umbrella rolls through the bedroom door, shattering the jamb, and detonates against the upside-down corpse of Featherfall. The building rocks, the floor buckles and the room half collapses to the level below. The red dots harassing Donut all disappear, and Carl thinks they fried Featherfall's loot.
beats.gist: Carl pulls the ticket expecting custard, gets a fireball, and blows up Featherfall's corpse.

beats.headline: Three spots left
beats.text: Shut in a train car with no doors to the outside, Carl prepares a smoke curtain and moves the ticket to his hotlist. It has three scratch-off spots left. If whatever is out there breaks in, they are screwed, and he knows he won't be saved by a glob of custard this time.
beats.gist: Carl readies a smoke curtain and moves the ticket to his hotlist.
